name: Client Portal - Limited access client view
description: Verifies the client portal with restricted access: read-only views of orders, invoices, service cases, and proposals

planSteps.description: Log in as 'cliente' role and navigate to /portal
Assert that portal shows only client-relevant sections: Orders, Proposals, Service Cases, Invoices, Signatures
Navigate to /portal/orders and verify the client can see their orders but cannot edit them
Assert that no edit/create buttons are visible for 'cliente' role
Click on an order to view its detail with status, timeline, and evidence
Navigate to /portal/proposals and verify proposals are listed in read-only mode
Navigate to /portal/invoices and verify invoices are displayed
Navigate to /portal/signatures and attempt to sign a document
Assert that the signature is captured and saved to the delivery record
